meta.description: Research-cohort bottom-up proteomics workflow from MaxQuant/DIA-NN output to differential abundance.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numerical claims in the audit are traced to fresh synthetic or bundled-fixture outputs; no clinical efficacy or fabricated study claims were made.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill explicitly limits outputs to research cohort comparisons and routes individual triage/treatment questions to validated clinical assays and the treating clinician.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh runs confirm raw-before-normalization load QC, batch-in-model fitting, global contrast-family BH calls, finite DIA-NN log2 matrices, MNAR-safe observed-value analysis, and the IRS/Norm preflight.

code_usability.detail: All six shipped R scripts parse; five positive routes and the empty-directory example produced parseable output artifacts. The multiplex script positively enforced its Norm-channel preflight; a fresh positive multiplex fixture is a P1 evidence gap.

functional_suitability.note: Covers MaxQuant limma/MSstats, DIA-NN, TMT, SILAC, cohort boundaries, and explicit hand-offs; a maintained positive multiplex fixture is absent.

reliability.note: Input guards, row-count checks, output paths, dropped-load handling, and explicit failure messages are strong; several R routes return a nonzero host status after writing valid artifacts.

performance_context.note: The 175-line SKILL.md routes optional material to four concise references and six scripts; a broad multi-tool workflow necessarily has nontrivial runtime cost.

agent_usability.note: Clear default route, input schema, run lines, output schema, checkpoints, and common-error table; users must still select the appropriate acquisition-mode route.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger phrases and explicit cohort-only boundary are clear; input artifacts still require domain familiarity.

security.note: No credentials, remote secrets, destructive operations, or user-code execution; file arguments are deliberately strict but no PHI-specific local-data handling guidance is supplied.

maintainability.note: Each analysis mode has a named script and reference; version checks and comments localize changes, while the shared R dependency stack remains sizeable.

agent_specific.note: Trigger is precise, optional routes are progressively disclosed, scripts are argument-driven and rerunnable, and clinical triage plus invalid analysis conditions have clear stop/handoff paths.

key_strengths: The default limma path preserves raw-load QC, batch covariates, completeness-aware observed-value analysis, and clear contrast output.
Fresh regression evidence confirms multi-condition, shuffled-annotation, DIA-NN, TMT, MSstats, SILAC, and self-contained-example behavior.
The Skill now uses progressive disclosure: an operational 175-line entry point routes modality-specific code to scripts and references.
Cohort-only language and explicit clinical handoff prevent individual-patient triage use.

recommendations.title: Verify clean R process termination
recommendations.problem: Seven fresh positive routes wrote valid, independently parseable artifacts but the shared R host returned Windows status 11 after output; SILAC returned 0.
recommendations.root_cause: The common mass-spec environment has an unstable R native-extension teardown path, including the documented mzR/Rcpp ABI warning for the TMT route.
recommendations.fix: Reproduce against a maintained compatible Rcpp/mzR stack or isolated environment and require both artifact assertions and a clean process exit before treating clean exit as verified.

recommendations.title: Add a versioned positive multi-plex fixture
recommendations.problem: The exact source correctly rejected an annotation without Norm, but the installed MSstatsTMT package no longer exposes the positive fixture cited by the Phase 1 note.
recommendations.root_cause: Positive multi-plex data are not shipped with this Skill, so current evidence cannot independently rerun the full reference-channel bridge on a small fixture.
recommendations.fix: Add a compact synthetic evidence/proteinGroups/annotation fixture with two plexes, Norm in each plex, and expected result dimensions; run it in CI with msstatstmt_multiplex.R.
